coach_bio.title: Who am I?
coach_bio.intro: This is a fictional demo team. The public SmallSide repository and site always ship this season so no real team, coach or child identity is exposed here — fork the repo and configure your own team with tools/new-season.html.
coach_bio.day_job: Not a real coach — this profile exists only to demonstrate the season/team configuration a coach fills in for their own fork.
coach_bio.plan: No real practices are run against this season. It exists to show how a season, league profile and team identity are configured without editing application code.
